theoryExam: The site of the theory exam
mockExam: This will be a mock exam, as agreed with your trainer.

refusal.bannedForever: The ban holds until the training department lifts it.
refusal.open: Once that training is closed, you can ask for another one.
refusal.waitUntil_one: You can ask for the next training from {{date}} UTC: {{count}} day to go.
refusal.waitUntil_other: You can ask for the next training from {{date}} UTC: {{count}} days to go.
refusal.hours: This training asks for {{minimum}} connection hours, and you have {{hours}}.
refusal.hoursNeeded: This training asks for {{minimum}} connection hours.

request.title: Ask for a training
request.lead: Choose the path and say when you are free: the training department receives the request, checks it and assigns you a trainer. Before a training you must have passed the theory exam of the rating.
request.youHint: They come from the network at your last sign in and are changed there: they are updated here when you sign in again.
request.nothingNext: No training to ask for after your rating
request.sent: Request for the {{rating}} training sent: the training department will check it.

hints.position: Type to search among the positions the division trains this rating on.
hints.availabilityText: When you can do the training: days and times, with the time zone.
hints.notesText: What the training department or the trainer should know.

theory.question: Have you passed the theory exam for {{rating}}?
theory.description: Before a training you must have passed the theory exam of the rating. Whoever approves the request checks it.

declined.title: Before asking for the training you must pass the {{rating}} theory exam.
declined.description: The request is recorded as refused, and no email is sent. Once you have passed the theory exam, ask for the training again.

mine.title: My trainings
mine.lead: Your requests and your trainings, ATC and pilot: what you can ask for on each path, and how each request is going.
mine.none: You have not asked for a training yet.
mine.noneDescription: When you ask for one, you find the request here and how it goes on.
mine.canAsk: You can ask for the training
mine.readyForExamOn: Your trainer marked you ready for the {{rating}} exam.
mine.theoryRefusal: Refused by the hub: you answered that you had not passed the theory exam yet.
mine.cancelDescription: It stays among your trainings as cancelled, and makes you wait for nothing: you can ask for another one whenever you like.

staff.title: Requests and trainings
staff.description: Every training of the division, from the request to the report: accept or refuse a request, and assign its trainer.

theoryReminder.title: Before accepting, check that {{trainee}} has passed the {{rating}} theory exam.
theoryReminder.declared: The trainee declared it passed on {{date}}.

decision.theory: Refused by the hub on {{date}}: the trainee answered that the theory exam was not passed yet.

trainer.none: No trainer yet: an accepted training waits for one as long as it takes.
trainer.noCandidates: Nobody can train it now: the staff of the training who has signed in to the hub at least once and has a rating on this path at least {{rating}}.
trainer.noOtherCandidates: Nobody else can train it now: the staff of the training who has signed in to the hub at least once and has a rating on this path at least {{rating}}.

assign.assigned: Trainer assigned: {{name}}. They will be asked to sign in again before they can conduct it.

hints.trainerVid: The staff of the training who has signed in to the hub at least once, with a rating on this path at least the one trained. The trainer is written to, and so is the trainee.

accept.title: Accept the request?
accept.description: The trainee is told by email. A trainer is assigned afterwards, whenever one is found.

reject.title: Refuse the request?
reject.description: The reason goes to the trainee by email and on their trainings page. A refusal makes them wait for nothing.

hints.reason: As the trainee will read it: for example, the connection hours they still need.

sheets.title: Evaluation sheet
sheets.description: The items a trainer marks after a session, per path and rating: the practical ones with a grade from 1 to 5, the theory ones as done, not done or to improve. The trainee reads them in their report.

hints.rating: The sheet the item is on: only the ratings with a practical training can be chosen.
hints.section: How the trainer marks the item: practice with a grade from 1 to 5, theory as done, not done or to improve.
hints.title: As the trainer and the trainee read it, in every language of the division.
hints.sort: The place of the item in the sheet of its rating: lower numbers first.
hints.isActive: An item switched off is left out of new reports; the reports already written keep it as it was.

delete.title: Delete the item?
delete.description: Only an item no report has used is deleted; an item already used is switched off.

settings.title: Training settings
settings.description: What the training department changes without a release: the rules of a request, the times of the dates, the positions trained on.

fields.minimumHours: Minimum hours to ask for a training
fields.cooldownDays: Days to wait after a training
fields.noShowCooldownDays: Days to wait after a no-show
fields.maxResponseDays: Days to choose a date before the training closes
fields.responseReminderDays: Days without a chosen date before the trainer is alerted
fields.conflictPolicy: When a proposed date meets the calendar
fields.reminderLeadHours: Hours before a session the reminder is sent

hints.minimumHours: Connection hours as a controller for an ATC rating, as a pilot for a pilot rating. A member with fewer cannot ask for that rating. No row: no threshold.
hints.maxResponseDays: Empty: a training never closes by itself, and the staff closes it by hand.
hints.conflictKinds: A proposed date that falls on an entry of one of these kinds is handled as the setting above says.
hints.hiddenPositions: The trainees are offered every position of the division a rating is trained on, the military ones included, except these.
hints.theoryExamUrl: Shown with the question on the theory exam, and to whoever approves a request.

conflictPolicy.Warn: Warn, and let the trainer confirm

errors.ratingNotTrained: This rating has no practical training.
errors.ratingTwice: This rating has more than one row.
errors.positionUnknown: The division no longer trains on this position: take it out of the list.
errors.calendarKindUnknown: One of these is not a kind of the calendar.
errors.sheetItemUsed: A report has already used this item: switch it off instead of deleting it.
errors.requestBanned: You have a ban from the training: while it holds you cannot ask for a training.
errors.requestOpen: You already have a training open on this path: one at a time.
errors.requestWaiting: The waiting after your last training on this path is not over yet.
errors.requestNothingToAsk: There is no training to ask for on this path after your rating.
errors.requestHoursUnknown: The hub does not know your connection hours yet: sign out and sign in again.
errors.requestHoursTooFew: You do not have the connection hours this training asks for yet.
errors.requestNoPosition: At the moment the division offers no position to train this rating on.
errors.requestRatingNotNext: This is no longer the rating you may ask for: reload the page.
errors.requestPositionUnknown: Choose a position from the list.
errors.requestPositionNotAsked: A training on this path has no position.
errors.requestNotCancellable: Only a request nobody has accepted yet can be cancelled.
errors.trainingNotRequested: Only a request waiting for acceptance can be accepted or refused.
errors.trainingNotAssignable: A trainer is assigned only to an accepted training that is still going on.
errors.trainerIsTrainee: Nobody is the trainer of their own training.
errors.trainerNotStaff: Only the staff of the training who has signed in to the hub at least once can be the trainer.
errors.trainerRatingTooLow: Their rating on this path is below the one this training is for.
errors.trainerAlready: They are the trainer of this training already.
errors.datesNotProposable: Dates are proposed only for a training with its trainer assigned and no date yet.
errors.slotPassed: This date has already gone by.
errors.slotEndsBeforeItStarts: The end comes before the start.
errors.slotTooLong: A date proposed lasts 12 hours at most.
errors.slotTwice: This date is among the ones proposed already.
errors.slotsTooMany: At most 10 dates are proposed to the trainee at a time.
errors.slotUnknown: This date is no longer among the ones proposed: reload the page.
errors.slotNotChoosable: A date is chosen only while the training waits for its date.
errors.dateNotSettable: A date is set only on a training with its trainer assigned that is still going on.
errors.dateBlocked: Something is in the calendar on that day already, and the division does not accept a date that meets it.
errors.dateNotConfirmed: Something is in the calendar on that day already: look at the warnings and confirm the date.
errors.trainingNotClosable: Only an accepted training that is still going on can be closed.

reminder.title: Reminders of the sessions
